basis: Standard list price per million text tokens for metered API use, read from each provider's own pricing pages. Not an invoice: a subscription or coding-plan route is billed by its plan, so its row is the metered API price of the same model. Updated by pull request.

openai/gpt-6-sol.note: Cache writes 2.50; requests over 272K input cost 2x input and 1.5x output (not visible per stage). Over ChatGPT sign-in this is the API-equivalent price, not the bill.

openai/gpt-6-astra.note: The pricing and model pages say 10/50 standard; one changelog entry says 5/25 from 2026-10-05, which the pricing page lists as the Batch/Flex rate. Cache writes 12.50; long context 20/2/75.

openai/gpt-5.6-sol.note: Promotional price for three months, at least through 2026-11-21; the list price before it was 5/30/0.50. Update this row when the promotion ends.

openai/gpt-5.6-terra.note: After the 2026-07-30 price cut (preview 2.50/15.00/0.25). Cache writes 1.25x input.

openai/gpt-5.6-luna.note: After the 80% price cut (preview 1.00/6.00/0.10). What GoCode bills for it was not found; this is OpenAI's API price.

zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3.note: The Coding Plan route is a subscription metered in credits; this is the Z.ai metered API price of GLM-5.3. Cached storage is free for a limited time.

zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3-flash.note: The Coding Plan route is a subscription metered in credits; this is the Z.ai metered API price of GLM-5.3-Flash. Cached storage is free for a limited time.

zhipuai-coding-plan/glm-5.3.note: Kilo's Zhipu AI Coding Plan route (a subscription). Zhipu publishes only CNY (8 input, 2 cached, 28 output per million at https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/guide/start/pricing); this row is Z.ai's international USD price for the same model, not a conversion.

xiaomi-token-plan-sgp/mimo-v2.6-pro.note: The Token Plan route is a subscription metered in credits; this is Xiaomi's pay-as-you-go price (CNY 3 / 0.025 / 6). No Singapore-specific price was found.

xiaomi-token-plan-sgp/mimo-v2.6-flash.note: The Token Plan route is a subscription metered in credits; this is Xiaomi's pay-as-you-go price (CNY 1 / 0.02 / 2). No Singapore-specific price was found.

kilo/z-ai/glm-5.3.note: Kilo Gateway charges the vendor's API rate with no markup; Z.ai's metered price of GLM-5.3, billed in prepaid Gateway credits, unlike the subscription coding-plan routes.

kilo/openai/gpt-6-sol.note: Kilo Gateway charges OpenAI's API rate with no markup. Through Kilo's OpenAI OAuth login the same model bills the ChatGPT subscription instead.

kilo/openai/gpt-6-astra.note: Kilo Gateway charges OpenAI's API rate with no markup; the long-context premium of the direct route applies the same way.

kilo/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.note: Kilo Gateway charges DeepSeek's API rate with no markup. DeepSeek bills peak and off-peak tiers; this is the peak rate (off-peak is half: 0.15 / 0.003 / 0.6).

kilo/anthropic/claude-opus-5.5.note: Kilo Gateway charges Anthropic's API rates with no markup. Cache writes 5.00.

claude-opus-5-5.note: 5-minute cache writes 5.00, 1-hour 8.00. The built-in claude provider reports its own cost, which is used before this estimate.

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Cache reads 0.10 from 2026-10-07 (0.20 before, per the Platform release notes). 5-minute cache writes 2.50.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.note: The cached rate is Anthropic's published 0.1x cache-read multiplier for this model. 5-minute cache writes 1.25.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.note: Route alias of claude-opus-5-5. 5-minute cache writes 5.00, 1-hour 8.00. The built-in claude provider reports its own cost, which is used before this estimate.

anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Route alias of claude-sonnet-5-5. Cache reads 0.10 from 2026-10-07 (0.20 before, per the Platform release notes). 5-minute cache writes 2.50.

anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5.note: Route alias of claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. The cached rate is Anthropic's published 0.1x cache-read multiplier for this model. 5-minute cache writes 1.25.

kilo/anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.note: Route alias of kilo/anthropic/claude-opus-5.5. Kilo Gateway charges Anthropic's API rates with no markup. Cache writes 5.00.
